name: mixer-activation-v2
authority: These definitions alone enable no runtime, effects, release or publication. Execution requires an implementing trusted installed binary, matching immutable identity/material, verified signed selection and all specified gates. Proposal/implementation/qualification status is tracked outside these byte-hashed files.
contract_format: bounded protocol reference with closed structural schemas; lexical, cross-field, full executable and authority checks remain mandatory; JSON Schema alone never authorizes execution

package.archive: one libmixer_vm_capability_experimental.a containing both C families and shared registry; public profiles/old C layouts unchanged

installed_policy.factory: validate identity and immutable canonical role-bound materials; derive policy AND construct concrete adapters from those snapshots, not caller DTOs/objects
installed_policy.payload: private updater immutable payload+opaque verified artifact from same pinned identity/verifier; no accepting validator callback exposed by new coordinator
installed_policy.resources: only min signed/installed base ceilings; capability quotas identity-bound; memory is linear-memory-only, no totalRSS claim
installed_policy.startup: installed exact defined no-argument export, once, effects off; exact defined void wake fixed by contract; no start section or release-selected entry
installed_policy.adapter_initialization: only after identity/material and complete payload validation; trusted private storage init may perform filesystem setup, distinguished from guest effect dispatch

api_prerequisites.name: bounded-same-config-validate-only
requirements: bounded admission before queued Data captures; reject busy/cancelled/late work
construction revalidates matching tuple; validation result cannot retarget immutable bytes

api_prerequisites.name: structured-machine-code-classification
requirements: checked native status/report consistency before using fields
closed stable native code mapping, unknown conservative
do not classify human text/substrings/description/status2 alone
separate guest trap, cancel, deadline, panic/quarantine, API/resource, unknown categories

api_prerequisites.name: zero-page-memory-parity
requirements: floor signed/installed positive bytes downward to exact0..64pages
matching defined0page modules preserve existing C/v3 semantics
if selected bridge cannot represent exact0, reject before staging; never round upward
standalone validate and construction use identical effective limits

lifecycle.effects_latch: effectsEverOpened permanent per-attempt bool, independent of earned health; guest/release cannot set it
order: verify installed descriptor/material, signatures/scope/assignment/limits, exact immutable payload/hash and full capability validation before staging/selection
reserve bounded owner before queue/capture and record durable startup attempt
construct same tuple and run installed startup exactly once with effects disabled
after every await, require same attempt generation/open latch/no cancellation/unexpired signed monotonic startup budget
publish successful current startup then privately enable effects; never expose raw bridge/development enable on OTA owner
successful turns may now dispatch signed-and-installed-granted effects while provisional
only real installed milestones and durable monotonic observation commit health; startup/enable/completion alone never health
lifecycle.startup_disabled_enqueues: unavailable completion remains permanently non-drainable after enable; no retroactive I/O
lifecycle.cancel_before_publish: retire later-created owner; no effects enable; close cannot be undone by late worker/timer
lifecycle.startup_deadline: signed minimum with installed1..60000ms, includes selection/validation/construction/startup; reject late completion, cooperative cancel, no hard preemption of decoder/constructor
lifecycle.post_enable_failure: stop admission and guest; recoveryRequired, never silent live guest replacement or immediate conflicting native launch; retain exit owners and reconcile effects
lifecycle.close: latch attempt closed before awaiting host/native cleanup; preserve real exit/ack ownership and bounded draining metadata; no fabricated release; indefinite hung/poison ownership possible
lifecycle.close_work: per owner one coalesced host-close Task plus one separate coalesced native-close dispatch job; both remain inside bounded ownership, no unbounded per-event jobs

health.milestones: nonempty installed stable identifiers<=16 plus monotonic observation1..3600seconds; only native embedding reports real completed milestones
health.provisional_effects: permitted only after private verified startup gate; may mutate external state before health; no rollback guarantee
health.retained_healthy: reverify exact private selection under same identity and documented retained-healthy authority, rerun disabled startup each process, then enable after current startup success; no invented current UI/FieldLog proof
health.durability_failure: no healthy return/invented commit; preserve uncertain durable state and stop/fail closed without replay reset

recovery.before_effects: candidate and at most one compatible retained healthy startup attempt, then explicit actual compiled native fallback
recovery.after_effects: recoveryRequired; no automatic live switch; caller reconciles possible committed I/O and unresolved exits
recovery.next_cold_start: new bounded attempt may choose compatible healthy/native fallback; previous external effects may persist and require data compatibility
recovery.rollback: new greater signed assignment sequence for older compatible payload; no lowering high-water
recovery.state: complete installed host/runtime/channel/installation match; old identity directory mismatch rejects without deletion/reinitialization; explicit per-runtime storage or separately reviewed migration
recovery.unknown: cancellation/native panic/poison/allocation/future codes not deterministic application failure; preserve bounded machine diagnostics, no payload/secret text

classification.context_required: native code plus checked outer status and operation/attempt facts; activation local cancelled/deadline overrides resulting VM cancellation as explicit cause
classification.typed_operation_failures: permissionDenied/unavailable/deadlineExceeded/ioFailure etc are capability results, not VM deterministic traps
classification.unknown: terminal conservative unknownInterruption; do not derive from status2/human text

preservation.old_entrypoints: old activation policy still guestABI1 with empty capability hashes/grants; no widened route/profile/default import admission

required_tests: v1/v2 canonical/signature/vector and all old negative acceptance preservation
identity2 domain+allfield mutations/canonical malformed/limit boundaries; captured bytes and concrete adapter binding
v3 Go/Swift independent CBOR/Ed25519 cross vectors, protocol/ABI/route/runtime/material/grant mismatch and replay
real Wasm full uncalled/import/start/wake/type/memory/limit rejects and same-config standalone validation proof
cancel/close/deadline at every await/publish/enable; startup disabled/trap zero dispatch; health not implied by startup or callback
actual private storage bytes + narrowed grants; deniedHTTP no adapter; no TLS bypass; native equalbits/lateexit/closed ack/count/rate/deadline queue races
signed durable v3 recovery, corruption/fault/reopen/old-store mismatch/newsequence rollback, no silent live replacement after effects
onearchive C family and16pool proof; typed classifier unknown/status2/text imitation tests
qualification_boundary: Contract bytes are not proof of implementation, validation, native I/O, actual health, full Swift/UI/FieldLog, complete build graph/consumption/embedding, published packaging, physical lifecycle/performance, signing/store/hosted/GA qualification. Those require separate accountable evidence.
